thread:
support-julia: Customer ACME (prod) reporting p99 spike on /v1/generate since 2026-03-01 08:15 UTC. p50 looks fine, p95 ~2x baseline. Attaching request_ids and a short trace. Can eng oncall triage?

ops-bot: ALERT: high_p99_latency service=api-gateway env=prod value=1243ms > threshold 800ms (alert_id=ALRT-7621)

liam-eng: Can you paste a sample request + trace id and the dashboard the customer shared? Also which model was in the request?

support-julia: Sample: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2","input":"long prompt...","max_tokens":1024}'```
Trace: 2026-03-01T08:16:12Z req_1192 (attached logs). Customer panel screenshot points to "Product > API Latency > p99 (last 1h)" from our product dashboard.

kevin-sre: Looking now. Note: our "Product" dashboard uses the rollup-derived series p99_rollup_request_duration while the eng-sre p99 panel runs histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)). Those two can diverge depending on rollup sampling and cross-pod aggregation.

anna-metrics: Queries I'm running:
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le))
// vs //
max_over_time(p99_rollup_request_duration{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])
```
I'll compare across the customer window (08:10-08:25).

kevin-sre: Quick result (08:12-08:18): raw histogram p99 ~= 980ms, rollup p99 ~= 1.3s. Explanation: a small number of requests (0.4%) hit nodes that were cold or had long GC stalls; rollup aggregation across instances amplifies the tail because of how we compute the stored quantile snapshot.

liam-eng: Possible mitigations: (A) short-term: route ACME traffic to redwood-v2-small variant (lower mem/latency) or increase min_replicas for redwood-v2-prod from 1->3; (B) warm KV caches / pin models; (C) add a traffic-splitting fallback to redwood-v2-small for 5% of requests. I can run a repro: send long-seq requests concurrency=40 to reproduce tail.

maria-product: From customer comms: they want an immediate workaround and a postmortem. We'll offer pinning + 24h monitoring and a credit for impact. Please confirm technical plan and a short note I can send.

support-julia: Sent customer an interim instruction to pin model to redwood-v2-small and add small client retry/backoff. They accepted temporary change, waiting for eng to confirm longer term plan.

anna-metrics: Reconciliation query to show both metrics side-by-side for the customer (shareable):
```promql
label_join(
  vector(1), "source", "", "",  /* helper */
) 
// simpler: run both panels in a single dashboard and annotate source names
```
Also creating a doc blurb: "Why rollup p99 != histogram_quantile p99" and adding it to the dashboard help.

kevin-sre: Action items I will take:
1) Open INFRA ticket to increase min_replicas for redwood-v2-prod to 3 for next 24h (INFRA-432).
2) Add dashboard annotation + update panel legend to show metric origin (rollup vs raw histogram).
3) Investigate cold start path and GC hotspots on nodes that report long tails.
I'll create an incident record.

liam-eng: I'll run the repro job now (job link: https://jobs.redwood.com/repro/2162345678). Will post logs and request_ids to this thread.

support-julia: FYI — customer confirmed the pinned variant reduced p99 on their side. They're waiting on our infra change and a follow-up.

kevin-sre: Marking short-term mitigation in place. Long-term: we'll tweak rollup algorithm and look at per-instance tail sampling to avoid this amplification.
